Web Development

Student Courses Bachelor's thesis

This is my Bachelor's thesis, titled Student Courses (RO: Cursuri Studenți - Lucrare Licență). The goal was to develop a website tailored for students who need access to various courses or specific course materials in text format for reports or projects. The platform allows users to upload course content as images, which are then converted and stored as text. Additionally, users can edit their personal information, customize their accounts with a logo, and, as administrators, manage both user accounts and course materials.
